items.item: Property A's Prop 19 treatment assumes it is the parent's principal residence and that the heir makes it their principal residence and claims the homeowners' exemption within the BOE windows. If not, full reassessment applies (modeled as an alternative: value shown in the projections).

items.item: Property B has two rental units. Rental property is not eligible for the parent-child family-home exclusion. Treatment of the owner-occupied third unit and any partial exclusion is unknown. The model applies full reassessment (conservative).

items.item: Owner reports Property A electricity at about $0 net, with a $10–20/mo solar credit. PG&E's Base Services Charge (a fixed daily charge) applies to almost all residential customers. The model applies the highest tier (conservative) net of the credit. The per-day tier amounts were not confirmed on the fetched advice-letter pages. CPUC guide context: NEM is guaranteed for 20 years and surplus annual generation is paid ≈2–3¢/kWh, so a $10–20/mo net credit depends on system size and usage (owner's figure still needs the bill).
items.action: Compare the monthly bill against the fixed charge line.
